story.title: Violence Breaks Out in Barcelona Amid General Strike Protests
story.summary: Tens of thousands participated in a general strike in Spain, organized by major unions to protest against high housing costs and the cost of living. Following a peaceful march in Barcelona, clashes erupted between protesters and riot police, with burning barricades reported and police using projectiles to disperse crowds as violence escalated in the city center.

timeline_highlights.title: Protests Erupt in India Demanding Resignation of Election Chief
timeline_highlights.summary: A youth group known as the 'Cockroach' movement has threatened to resume mass protests unless Gyanesh Kumar resigns as head of India's election commission. This demand follows allegations of election rigging, which have also prompted opposition parties, including Congress, to join the protests. Police have responded with tear gas to disperse demonstrators.

timeline_highlights.summary: Teddy Riner, the 37-year-old Olympic judo champion, has declared his candidacy for the French presidency in the 2027 election. He made the announcement via social media, amid a political landscape where public opinion is divided between far-left candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon and far-right candidate Marine Le Pen.

timeline_highlights.title: Spain Experiences First General Strike in 14 Years Amid Housing Crisis
timeline_highlights.summary: Millions of Spaniards participated in a general strike, the first in 14 years, to protest rising housing costs and stagnant wages. The strike led to significant disruptions across major cities, coinciding with upcoming parliamentary elections. Demonstrators expressed frustration over the affordability of housing, which has become a central issue in the country.

related_stories.title: Survivors Rescued After Brooklyn Building Collapse Leaves Two Dead
related_stories.summary: A partial collapse of a three-storey building in Brooklyn resulted in at least two fatalities and 17 injuries. The incident occurred shortly after 4 PM on November 11, with rescuers successfully pulling four survivors from the rubble. Firefighters are continuing their search for additional individuals who may be trapped beneath the debris.

related_stories.title: Two Iranian Men Convicted in UK for Spying on Journalists
related_stories.summary: A London court has convicted two Iranian citizens of spying on journalists associated with a Persian-language television station critical of the Iranian government. The court found that the men were promised rewards for sending intelligence back to Iran, and one of them was also convicted of planning a violent attack against the journalists.
